title: aspidium longicrure
intro: Aspidium longicrure, commonly known as the 'Rabbit's foot fern', is a species of plant belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, acting as an anti-inflammatory, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. Aspidium longicrure is also used for its therapeutic actions, such as soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and providing relief from respiratory problems. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
